content:
# Crossplane XRD + Composition (functions mode)

Layout:

```
crossplane/
├── functions.yaml                 # function-patch-and-transform pkg
├── providerconfigs/
│   ├── dev.yaml                   # aws-dev  (us-east-1)
│   └── prod.yaml                  # aws-prod (us-east-1 + replica us-west-2)
├── definition.yaml                # XRD: XAppStack / AppStack claim
├── composition.yaml               # pipeline: function-patch-and-transform
└── claims/
    ├── dev.yaml
    └── prod.yaml
```

---

## 1. `functions.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.8.2
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-s3
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-s3:v1.21.1
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-rds
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-rds:v1.21.1
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws-iam
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws-iam:v1.21.1
```

## 2. `providerconfigs/dev.yaml` / `prod.yaml`

Credentials never live in Git — they are pulled from a `Secret` that is itself
projected by External Secrets / SOPS-decrypted at bootstrap.

```yaml
# dev
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: IRSA            # controller pod assumes the dev deploy role
---
# prod
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-prod
spec:
  credentials:
    source: IRSA
```

Environment isolation = distinct `ProviderConfig` (distinct AWS account/role) selected
per-claim via `spec.parameters.environment`; nothing in a prod claim can touch dev MRs.

---

## 3. `definition.yaml` — XRD

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.platform.example.org
spec:
  group: platform.example.org
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - host
    - port
    - username
    - password
    - database
    - endpoint
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: [dev, prod]
                    region:
                      type: string
                      default: us-east-1
                    replicaRegion:
                      type: string
                      default: us-west-2
                    dbName:
                      type: string
                      default: appdb
                    dbUsername:
                      type: string
                      default: appuser
                    dbPasswordSecretRef:
                      type: object
                      description: Pre-existing K8s Secret holding the master password.
                      properties:
                        name: { type: string }
                        namespace: { type: string }
                        key: { type: string, default: password }
                      required: [name, namespace]
                    serviceAccount:
                      type: object
                      description: IRSA subject for the app service account.
                      properties:
                        namespace: { type: string, default: default }
                        name: { type: string, default: app }
                      required: []
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: EKS cluster OIDC provider ARN.
                    oidcProviderHost:
                      type: string
                      description: OIDC issuer host, e.g. oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/ABC123
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - dbPasswordSecretRef
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcProviderHost
              required: [parameters]
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketName: { type: string }
                roleArn: { type: string }
                dbEndpoint: { type: string }
```

---

## 4. `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.aws.platform.example.org
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  writeConnectionSecretsToNamespace: crossplane-system
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        patchSets:
          # ---- common: region + providerconfig + labels ------------------
          - name: common
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "aws-%s" }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.labels[env]
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
          # IAM is global — no region field
          - name: common-global
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "aws-%s" }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]

        resources:
          # =============================================================
          # S3 — bucket + versioning + SSE + public access block
          # =============================================================
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider: {}
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketPrefix
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "app-assets-" }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.id
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              # prod upgrades to KMS
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].sseAlgorithm
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map: { dev: "AES256", prod: "aws:kms" }

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          # =============================================================
          # RDS PostgreSQL
          # =============================================================
          - name: db-subnet-group
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: SubnetGroup
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  subnetIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      access: private
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          - name: rds
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "16.3"
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  maxAllocatedStorage: 100
                  storageType: gp3
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "Mon:04:00-Mon:05:00"
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: app-final
                  performanceInsightsEnabled: true
                  enabledCloudwatchLogsExports: ["postgresql", "upgrade"]
                  dbSubnetGroupNameSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  vpcSecurityGroupIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      role: database
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              # master password: referenced, never inlined
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbPasswordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key
              # env sizing
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map: { dev: db.t3.micro, prod: db.t3.medium }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map: { dev: "false", prod: "true" }
                  - type: convert
                    convert: { toType: bool }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map: { dev: "7", prod: "30" }
                  - type: convert
                    convert: { toType: int64 }
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string: { type: Format, fmt: "%s-rds" }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
            connectionDetails:
              - name: host
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: endpoint
              - name: port
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: port
              - name: username
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: username
              - name: password
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: password
              - name: endpoint
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
              - name: database
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName

          # =============================================================
          # IAM role for service accounts (IRSA)
          # =============================================================
          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-global
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccount.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccount.name
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [{
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": { "Federated": "%s" },
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                          "Condition": {
                            "StringEquals": {
                              "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com",
                              "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"
                            }
                          }
                        }]
                      }
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn

          - name: irsa-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common-global
              # least privilege: explicit actions, scoped to this bucket only
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: status.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: status.bucketName
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Sid": "ListScopedBucket",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s"
                          },
                          {
                            "Sid": "ObjectRW",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [
                              "s3:GetObject",
                              "s3:GetObjectVersion",
                              "s3:PutObject",
                              "s3:DeleteObject"
                            ],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                          }
                        ]
                      }
```

Note: no `"Action": "*"` and no `"Resource": "*"` anywhere — the policy is generated
from the composed bucket's actual name, so it cannot widen.

---

## 5. Claims

`claims/dev.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: web-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    dbName: appdb
    dbUsername: appuser
    dbPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-master-dev      # created by External Secrets / SOPS, never in Git
      namespace: dev
      key: password
    serviceAccount:
      namespace: dev
      name: web
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV123
    oidcProviderHost: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV123
  compositionRef:
    name: xappstacks.aws.platform.example.org
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: web-dev-db
```

`claims/prod.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: web-prod
  namespace: prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    replicaRegion: us-west-2
    dbName: appdb
    dbUsername: appuser
    dbPasswordSecretRef:
      name: rds-master-prod
      namespace: prod
      key: password
    serviceAccount:
      namespace: prod
      name: web
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD456
    oidcProviderHost: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD456
  compositionRef:
    name: xappstacks.aws.platform.example.org
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: web-prod-db
```

---

## Acceptance mapping

| Criterion | Where |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE + no public access | `BucketVersioning` Enabled, `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256 dev / KMS prod), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` all-true |
| RDS deletion protection, backups ≥7d, not public | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod` 7 (dev) / 30 (prod), `publiclyAccessible: false`, `storageEncrypted: true` |
| Secret not in Git | master password via `passwordSecretRef` to an externally-managed Secret; connection details surfaced only through `writeConnectionSecretToRef` |
| Least privilege IAM | `RolePolicy` generated from composed bucket name; enumerated actions, no wildcards; trust policy pinned to one `serviceaccount:ns:name` |
| Env isolation | `providerConfigRef` derived from `spec.parameters.environment` → separate AWS accounts/roles; separate claims, separate MR trees |
